corrections.was: Jensen tells Nvidia staff 'I HURT ALL OF YOU'... says he's in therapy, people present say
corrections.now: Jensen tells Nvidia staff 'I HURT ALL OF YOU'... says he's in therapy, says one person in the room
corrections.note: The headline attributed the therapy remark to more than one person present; the linked CNBC article cites one.

corrections.was: NYT: Justice Dept. investigators gather evidence Nvidia chips were ILLEGALLY DIVERTED to China...
corrections.now: NYT: Justice Dept. has evidence OTHER FIRMS illegally diverted Nvidia chips to China, sources say...
